tears as a verb, pronounced to rhyme with 'cares'

the opening letter of Ethiopia

explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital of Ethiopia' tempts you towards Addis Ababa, but it only means its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Pretoria is the administrative capital of South Africa, so it is an African city by example.

taken as written

clue.text: Member of secret society for seamen at sea

clue.text: Array of stars, fabulous naked, by the sound of it?

clue.text: Prediction of the war creates wound

indicators.note: breaking into something means entering it, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: to land a prize is to win it
